title: acer laurinum subsp. garrettii
intro: Acer laurinum subsp. garrettii, commonly known as Laurel Maple or Garrett's Maple, is a sub-species of the Acer laurinum plant, a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Acer laurinum subsp. garrettii include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which make it effective in treating wounds, skin conditions, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
